title: Spinnet Requested Host Operations (Plugin API Level 7)

operation.description: One Requested Host Operation. perform names the Host Service by its catalogue ID, one the catalogue offers at the request entry point; input is that operation's input, exactly as a script's call gives it (a bare string stands for its primary member), left out only when the operation takes none. id, closes_view and notify are common to every operation. closes_view closes the view once the operation succeeds and only then, so a refusal keeps the view to show why; host.showPluginSettings, which opens a sheet beside the view, takes no closes_view. notify asks for an operation_finished View Event when the outcome is ready, delivered only while the session exists and the requesting Action still handles it.

input.description: The operation's input, including the separately scoped Level 7 catalog refresh input.

answer.description: A Level 2 script's answer to a Level 1 view: Level 1's answer plus an optional operation. An operation may come with a view, a toast, both or neither, but not with close: an operation that should close the view says closes_view.

view.description: A Level 1 view, optionally with view_additions.

state.description: Any JSON, at most 64 KiB; null when absent.

allOf.description: An answer that closes the view describes none and requests nothing; use closes_view on the operation instead.
Only an answer with a view keeps a state.
